title: 第1章 流放穿越就得滚去诅咒之地第2章 暴打弟弟拥有神选者
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
菲尔德挤出灿烂的笑容，等待着父亲，也就是科特伯爵的宣判。
他原名秦浩，来自蓝星的华国，穿越来这个世界，才短短三天。
好消息是伯爵的后代。
坏消息非常不受待见。
“菲尔德，你已经成年了，就像成熟的雄狮，是时候去开拓自己的事业。”衣着华丽的中年男子，语言中夹杂了振奋人心的词汇，但老伯爵说话有气无力，神情萎靡，这番话仿佛笑话一般。
在场的所有人，眼中都充斥着戏谑。
伯爵停顿了片刻，注意力不太集中，等回过神，居然忘记自己说到哪里了。
原主是个非常善良的人，他将觉醒斗气的药剂，谦让给了自己的弟弟，将去法师学院深造的机会，让给自己的妹妹，他甚至能友善对待任何一个仆人。照理来说，这样的好人，应该受人尊敬才是。可惜，他是贵族，从贵族的角度，原主即为懦弱无能的废物。
老伯爵身旁的熟女，便是菲尔德的后妈。
丰腴的美艳少妇，坐在端庄的领主次座上，优雅地端起茶杯吻了一口，随后放下茶杯，能拉丝的丹凤眼瞥了眼菲尔德，阳光勾勒出的赭色深影，凸显出鼻梁的高挺，后妈高傲地扬起臻首，几乎拿下巴对着菲尔德“广阔北境的夜幕领，将是你的男爵领，足够你大展拳脚。”
“果然，就算是尽力讨好每个人，依旧免不了流放的命运。”
微微有些眩晕，原主被众人欺凌后病死，却让自己来接这烂摊子。菲尔德用力咬紧嘴唇，堪堪稳住了心神。
随即，菲尔德冷笑一声，原主真是够蠢的，想靠善良在贵族中生存下去。
后妈的眸子朝下漫不经心地瞥了眼，睥睨道“有意见？”
“呼~”
用力挤压出心中的郁气，菲尔德收敛起微笑，用平淡的语气回应道“如你所愿，我的父亲。”
他的便宜爹已经被后妈榨干了，凡事都听老婆的安排。
“噗嗤~蠢货！”
不知哪个亲戚笑出了声，夹杂着某个尖酸刻薄的辱骂。
北境，居住了人类和兽人两大种族，充满了血腥、暴力与野蛮，十年前，神圣狮鹫帝国利用腐化雾霾，屠戮了三十万兽人大军，那里恐怕已经住满了肮脏的哥布林和巨魔。

当然，现在的北境更糟了。
三十万的兽人大军，以及北境所有人类和动物，全变成了腐化生物，长年藏身在死亡雾霾中，成为人间炼狱的代名词。皇室组织过三次收复失地运动，都以全军覆没告终。
北境大大小小的领地，不过是存在于口头上的土地罢了，狗都不去。
绝大多数时候，都不会有人提起。
那里就是个诅咒之地，甚至还要糟糕，就算是逃跑的农奴或罪犯，也不会选择往夜幕领跑。
没事，我还有挂。
菲尔德默默安慰自己，心念一动，透明的地图跳出来，同时地图上还标注出一个缓慢移动的绿点。
“去准备吧。”伯爵显得很疲倦，脸色惨白。
content_en:
Field squeezed out a bright smile and waited for the sentencing of his father, Earl Kurt.
His original name was Qin Hao, he came from the Chinese country of Blue Star, and it had only been three days since he traveled to this world.
The good news is that the Earl is descended.
Bad news is very unpopular.
"Field, you have grown up, like a mature lion, it is time to start your own career." The middle-aged man in gorgeous clothes mixed his words with inspiring words, but the old earl spoke weakly and looked depressed, making these words seem like a joke.
The eyes of everyone present were filled with amusement.
The earl paused for a moment, not concentrating too much. When he came back to his senses, he actually forgot where he had said it.
The original owner was a very kind person. He humbly gave the potion for awakening fighting spirit to his younger brother, and gave the opportunity to further his studies at the Mage Academy to his younger sister. He could even be kind to any servant. Logically speaking, such a good person should be respected by others. It's a pity that he is a noble. From the perspective of the noble, the original owner is a cowardly and incompetent waste.
The mature woman next to the old earl is Field's stepmother.
The plump and beautiful young woman sat on the dignified lord's second seat. She elegantly picked up the teacup and kissed her. Then she put down the teacup and glanced at Field with her silky red phoenix eyes. The deep ocher shadow outlined by the sun highlighted the high bridge of her nose. The stepmother raised her head proudly and almost held her chin towards Field. "The night territory of the vast northern border will be your barony, enough for you to show off your talents."
"Sure enough, even if you try your best to please everyone, you still cannot avoid the fate of exile."
Slightly dizzy, the original owner died of illness after being bullied by everyone, but he let himself take over the mess. Field bit his lip hard and calmed down.
Immediately, Field sneered. The original owner was really stupid and wanted to survive among the nobility by relying on kindness.
The stepmother glanced down casually and said with a look of disdain, "Do you have any opinions?"
"Huh~"
Squeezing out the depression in his heart, Field suppressed his smile and responded in a calm tone, "As you wish, my father."
His cheap father has been squeezed out by his stepmother, and he obeys his wife's arrangements in everything.
"Pfft~ Idiot!"
One of the relatives laughed out loud, mixed with some harsh insult.
The northern border is inhabited by two major races, humans and orcs. It is full of blood, violence and barbarism. Ten years ago, the Holy Griffin Empire used the corrupted haze to massacre an army of 300,000 orcs. The place is probably already filled with dirty goblins and trolls.
Of course, the North is worse now.
The three hundred thousand orc army, as well as all humans and animals in the north, have all turned into corrupt creatures, hiding in the haze of death for many years, becoming synonymous with purgatory on earth. The royal family organized three movements to recover the lost territory, all of which ended in the annihilation of the entire army.
The large and small territories in the north are just lands that exist in words, and dogs will not go there.
Most of the time, no one mentions it.
It was a cursed place, and it was even worse. Even escaped serfs or criminals would not choose to lead them into the night.
It's okay, I'm still hanging up.
Field comforted himself silently, and with a thought, a transparent map popped up, and at the same time, a slowly moving green dot was marked on the map.
"Go and get ready." The count looked very tired and his face was pale.
